text:
anya: FYI I noticed exported audit rows for routing decisions are opaque. We need to be able to answer "which rule matched and why" from the export alone. Can we add decision lineage to the export format?

kai: Agreed. At minimum we should emit a matched_rule_id and a small reason token (e.g., "latency_preference", "quota_fallback").

maria: Concern: including full rule objects in every row will explode size. What's the plan to keep exports reasonable for large tenants?

sam: Proposal: NDJSON rows reference policy snapshots by hash. The export bundle includes a manifest that maps hash->filepath (policies/<hash>.json). Rows stay compact; consumers can fetch snapshots if they need to replay.

olga: I like that. For compliance we often need the exact effective config; bundle should optionally embed the referenced snapshots. Add an `embed_snapshots` flag.

anya: Sketch of an event row I had in mind:

{tenant:acme, ts:2026-03-17T14:02:33Z, actor:policy-engine@redwood, event_type:route_decision, policy_hash:sha256:abc123, matched_rule:route-42, decision_reason:quota_exhausted_burst_fallback}

sam: Also suggest a small `routing_decision` object instead of scattering keys: {reason, matched_rule, metadata}. Metadata can be optional metrics like latency_ms or queue_depth to help ops triage without fetching snapshots.

kai: Internal API debate: top-level flat keys are easier for quick grep, but structured field future-proofs us. I'm leaning routing_decision obj.

maria: We need PII handling for actor fields (service account emails). Exports should accept `pii_mode` param: redact|pseudonymize|plain. If pseudonymize, include pseudonym_map.json in bundle accessible to tenant admins.

olga: Security: pre-signed snapshot links TTL must align with export retention. Also sign the bundle manifest so customers can verify integrity.

anya: Operational constraints: only include snapshots referenced by events in the export's time range. If a referenced snapshot has been GC'd, either embed or mark `snapshot_unavailable`. Enterprise customers should default to embed.

sam: For large ranges we should support chunked bundles: export_manifest.json with parts and checksums, plus NDJSON parts. Consumers can download parts selectively.

kai: Add telemetry counters: export.metrics.snapshots_included and export.metrics.total_bytes, plus counts of parts. Helps billing and ops.

maria: Console UX: show condensed who/what/why in the timeline and allow expand to render referenced policy (with fallback UI if snapshot_unavailable). Add toggles for embed_snapshots and pii_mode in the export modal.

olga: Implementation note: exporter service resolves hashes at generation time and must enforce tenant isolation on snapshots. If a snapshot missing, exporter should try a short backfill fetch then mark unavailable.

anya: Action items: sam + kai to add sample NDJSON + manifest to docs; olga run staging exports to validate sizes; maria add UI toggles; anya draft API query params.

sam: Sample manifest I'll drop in docs branch `audit-export-snapshots` today. Example manifest idea: {"export_id":"exp-2469-001","time_range":["2026-03-01","2026-03-17"],"parts":["part-000.ndjson"],"policies":{"sha256:abc123":"policies/sha256_abc123.json"}}

kai: I'll author the API spec PR adding `routing_decision` object and query params `embed_snapshots`, `pii_mode`, `chunk_size`. Backcompat: defaults to current compact export shape.

deploy-bot: deploy 2469130175 started by @kai - export-api v2 (manifest + snapshot refs)

olga: After deploy I'll schedule a staging run to validate manifest integrity and measure bundle sizes. Will report back.

maria: Ping me when the API spec lands, I'll wire the console toggles and show mockups. :thumbsup:

anya: Thanks everyone. We'll reconvene after the staging validation to finalize defaults.
